name: Integration for CF7 to Textdrip
author: Pranshtech Solutions Private Limited

sections.description:
Integration for CF7 to Textdrip seamlessly connects your Contact Form 7 forms with Textdrip CRM. Capture form submissions and automatically send contact data to your Textdrip campaigns.

Key Features

  • Connect Contact Form 7 forms to Textdrip CRM
  • Map form fields to Textdrip contact fields
  • Assign submissions to specific Textdrip campaigns
  • Easy setup with API key integration
  • Fetch campaigns directly from Textdrip
  • Secure data transmission

How it works

  1. Enter your Textdrip API key
  2. Select which Contact Form 7 forms to integrate
  3. Choose a Textdrip campaign for each form
  4. Form submissions are automatically sent to Textdrip
sections.installation:
1. Install Textdrip CF7 Connector either via the WordPress.org plugin directory, or by uploading the files to your
    server.
  2. Important: This plugin requires Contact Form 7 to be installed and activated first.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. You will see the Textdrip CF7 icon in your sidebar, below the Plugins section in the wp-admin area of your site.
    Click on it.
  5. Add your Textdrip API Key, select forms, and assign campaigns
  6. That’s it! Form submissions will now be sent to Textdrip

Privacy notices

In this plugin, the contact form submitter’s personal data may be sent to the service provider. Thus, confirming the provider’s privacy policy is recommended.

  • Privacy Policy (Textdrip)
  • Terms & Conditions (Textdrip)

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 plugin (required)
sections.faq:
What exactly does Integration for CF7 to Textdrip do?

Integration for CF7 to Textdrip captures submissions from your Contact Form 7 forms and sends the contact data to your Textdrip CRM account, where you can manage leads and campaigns.

Where do I get my Textdrip API key?

You can find your API key in your Textdrip account settings under API or Developer settings.

Can I use multiple campaigns?

Yes, you can assign different campaigns to different Contact Form 7 forms.

What data is sent to Textdrip?

The plugin sends name, email, phone number, and assigns the contact to your selected campaign.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all communication with Textdrip’s API is done over secure HTTPS connections.
